user.title: Connect to GenWave
user.description: Enter your GenWave station's URL and an announce token, generated once from the station's Announcements page (reveal-once).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate GenWave
reauth_confirm.description: The announce token for this GenWave station was refused. Generate a fresh one from the station's Announcements page and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that GenWave URL. Check the address and that the station is running.
error.invalid_auth: The announce token was refused. Check the token, or generate a fresh one on the station's Announcements page.
error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a URL. Include the scheme (https or http) and the host.

abort.already_configured: This GenWave station is already configured.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

announce_token_refused.message: The announce token was refused — reauthenticate the integration.

multiple_entries_configured.message: More than one GenWave station is configured — genwave.announce cannot pick one.

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Speak a message through your GenWave station's DJ, on air in the next break.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text to speak. Up to 280 characters (the station's own hard limit).

verbatim.name: Verbatim
verbatim.description: Speak the message exactly as written. When off, the on-air persona works it into copy in character, always preserving the message's own words.

ttl_seconds.name: Time to live
ttl_seconds.description: How long the message stays eligible to air before it expires unspoken, in seconds (60-3600). Defaults to 900 (15 minutes) when omitted.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: A specific station voice to speak this message, if the station has more than one. Defaults to the station's own voice when omitted.
